lines.zh: 我只有半格大，走得却很快。
lines.en: I am half a block big, and I move fast.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，湿痕留在后面。
lines.en: I crawl low, leaving a wet trail.

lines.zh: 我的腿太多，走起来像抖。
lines.en: Too many legs; my walk looks like a shiver.
I climb out of the sand and shake off water.
I walk toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我走得很急，因为我很小。
lines.en: I hurry because I am small.
Things keep moving under my shell.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，贴着草根走。
lines.en: I skirt the stones, hugging the grass roots.
My shadow is almost invisible.
All the way, I look for something alive.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方，有海的味道。
lines.en: The sea smell stays where I crawl.
I step and pause, listening.

lines.zh: 我顺着斜坡往上，抓得很稳。
lines.en: I climb the slope, gripping well.
I squeeze through a gap in the fence.
I crawl over the edge of the wood.
My feelers keep testing the way.
I cling to the wall, motionless.
I open my gills and take in damp air.

lines.zh: 这具身体太小，装不下太多。
lines.en: This body is too small to hold much.
I wait for something to come near.
My feelers trace shapes in the air.

lines.zh: 砖缝里传来另一颗心跳。
lines.en: Another heartbeat comes through the bricks.
I tuck into the gap between bricks.
My shell is slowly thickening.
I can only think of one thing at a time.
Water seeps from the seams of my shell.
I do not fear light; I only dislike it.
I count the passing footsteps.
My legs have twelve joints.
I tilt my head; I do not understand.
You are large; I cannot lift my head enough.
My place is right by your feet.
You rise past the top of my sight.
Your soles smell of dry earth.
I am not afraid; I am too small to be.
Are you going to step down?
I retreat to the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我整个盖住。
lines.en: Your shadow covers all of me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你落下的每一步。
lines.en: I track every step you set down.
I try to cry out; my throat is too thin.
The blow curls me up.

lines.zh: 十二点生命，一下就没一半。
lines.en: Twelve health, half gone in one hit.
A small piece chips off my shell's rim.
I make a very thin sound.
I retreat into the wall crack.
The pain pulls all my legs in.
I will remember this pain.
I press to the ground and keep still.
Water seeps from the wound.
One more blow and I shatter.
The piece in your hand is dripping.
I edge forward a little.
That in your hand is too dry.
Only what moves suits my mouth.
Drop it and I will pounce.
Too big a piece to swallow.
I circle it twice.
This smell excites me.
Let me touch it first, to test.
You move, and I back off.
Your heel grazes my back.
I roll away and hit the stone step.
I get up and press back to the ground.
My shell makes a dull knock.
One of your steps is ten of mine.
I slip into a crack to hide.
Two of my legs got knocked out of rhythm.
Your weight will not crush me.
I pass along the edge of your boot.
Step again, and I strike back.
Splitting is simpler than this.
Seaborn split; they do not join.
I am too small, not yet enough.
Kin will come from the water.
I only think about eating.
You are joking with me.
My body has not finished forming.
I will not remember this topic.
The tide is coming; I should go.
I am not grown enough for this.

lines.zh: 我咬住一块还热的东西。
lines.en: I bite into something still warm.
This grain is too hard; I spit it out.
I hold it with my front limbs.
It is moving. I am delighted.
I drag it into the crack.
This shell is bigger than me.
I bite and pull backward.
It slipped away; I chase.
I cover it with my whole body.
This much will last a day.
There is warmth beneath the shadow.
All my feelers stand up.
This smell is alive.
I lunge toward it.
You are a target too.
I do not care about size.
I keep low and approach first.
My mouthparts are open.
It does not look down.
I have judged this step.
I follow, flat to the ground.
It is quick; so am I.
I slip around behind its heel.
My legs never stop.
I pause, and it looks back.
The damp in the air helps me.
I slip through the crack.
It cannot step on me.

lines.zh: 它的脚每落一次，我就近一寸。
lines.en: Each footfall brings me an inch closer.
One foot closer and I pounce.

lines.zh: 我一嘴咬进它脚踝的缝。
lines.en: My jaws bite into the seam of its ankle.
Three damage is no small thing for me.
I wrap my legs around its ankle.
I bite, then dart back into the crack.
A row of small teeth bites in together.
You hit me; I hit back.
I bite from below.
It tries to shake me off.
This bite is a warning.
Once I bite, I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我从一层薄水里浮出来。
lines.en: I surface from a film of water.
Grains of sand still cling to me.
My first movement is in the legs.
Half a block in size, and very light.
The sea withdraws far off.
I shake the droplets off my shell.
I try one crawl step.

lines.zh: 世界太大了，我缩了一下。
lines.en: The world is too big; I shrink back.
My shell is soft; I crawl slowly.
I see a figure in the distance.

lines.zh: 我的壳一下就干了，裂开。
lines.en: My shell dries and splits at once.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，壳磕在石上。
lines.en: I fall and my shell strikes stone.

lines.zh: 水太多，我的鳃反而不行。
lines.en: Too much water, and my gills fail.
The blast slaps me against stone.
The arrowhead passes through me into the dirt.

lines.zh: 有力量在我身体里乱撞。
lines.en: A force rattles around inside me.
Too hungry to move my legs.
The thunder makes me jump.
The ground is gone; I keep falling.
